blocks.title: Digital entrepreneurship
blocks.text: Digital entrepreneurship technology aur online platforms ke zariye business ke khayalat banana, chalana aur barhana hai.

Digital entrepreneurship ka matlab hai technology aur online platforms ke zariye business ke khayalat banana, chalana aur barhana. Yeh logon ko innovative (naye andaz ke) digital hal se asal zindagi ke masle hal karne mein madad deti hai. Entrepreneurs (karobar shuru karne wale) duniya bhar ke customers tak pohanchne ke liye social media, e-commerce websites aur freelancing platforms use karte hain. Innovation (jiddat) badalti market ki zarooratein poori karne wale naye products aur services banane mein aham kirdar ada karti hai. Yeh shoba talaba ko mauqa deta hai ke apne takhleeqi khayalat ko kamyab digital karobar mein badlein.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Zyada tar kamyab entrepreneurs paidaishi risk lene wale nahi hote; woh tajurbe se risk lene ki salahiyat seekhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Digital entrepreneurship kya hai, aur entrepreneurs kin teen platforms se gahakon tak pohanchte hain?
blocks.explanation: Technology aur online platforms se business ideas banana, chalana aur barhana. Platforms: social media, e-commerce websites aur freelancing platforms.

items: Digital entrepreneurship: online platforms se karobar; asal masail ke digital hal.
Innovation nayi products aur services ki kunji hai.
